pronunciation.note: 核心拼写 ck 常对应 /k/；教材 Sound 以 click/check 为主。

wordForms.forms: careless adj. 粗心的；carelessly adv. 粗心地
necessary 必要的；unnecessary 不必要的
use 使用；used 使用过的/过去式；unused 未使用的

wordForms.examTip: 虽教材句用 as heavy as，考试常连带考比较级拼写。

wordForms.forms: delete 删除；Recycle Bin 回收站
wordForms.examTip: 删除文件后通常移到回收站。

examPoints.example: It was as ___ as four elephants.
I ___ (careless) dropped milk on the keyboard.
You can set a password by ___ (use) letters and numbers.
密码被弟弟乱用、键盘进牛奶、电脑变慢三类问题对应解决办法。
examPoints.answer: 按 Reading time 建议匹配

transformations.from: The computer was the size of a room.
transformations.to: The computer was as big as a room.
transformations.point: 用 as ... as 表示同级大小。

transformations.from: Use eight different letters, numbers and symbols to set a password.
transformations.to: Set a password by using eight different letters, numbers and symbols.
transformations.point: use ... to do 与 by V-ing。

transformations.from: Close programs that you do not use.
transformations.point: 从句与形容词 unused 的简化表达。
